title: Add Bearer auth to MCP endpoint
description:
Add authentication middleware to protect the MCP endpoint from unauthorized access.

## Requirements
- Validate incoming requests have `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- Compare token against `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` environment variable
- Return 401 Unauthorized if token is missing or invalid
- Allow requests through if token matches

## Implementation Notes
- Add Starlette middleware or use FastMCP's built-in auth if available
- The CORS middleware already allows the Authorization header
- Keep the health endpoint (/api/health) unauthenticated for monitoring
- Update README with new env var documentation

## Files to modify
- `api/mcp.py` - Add auth middleware
- `README.md` - Document MCP_AUTH_TOKEN env var
